_meta.description: Positional chess rules — pattern-to-rule mappings for PV line classification fallback
_meta.match_strategy: Pattern detected from PV line analysis in line_parser.py

loses_pawn.rule: Don't give away pawns without compensation.

loses_exchange.rule: Don't trade a rook for a minor piece without compensation.
loses_exchange.short: You lost the exchange (rook for bishop/knight).

loses_queen.rule: Protect your queen at all costs.

allows_checkmate.rule: Always check for checkmate threats before making your move.

allows_fork.rule: Watch for knight forks on your king and queen.

allows_pin.rule: Avoid placing pieces on lines with your king.

allows_skewer.rule: Keep your valuable pieces off the same line.

allows_discovered_attack.rule: Watch for pieces that can move to reveal attacks.

misses_check.rule: Always look for checks first — they force responses.
misses_check.short: You missed a check that wins material.

allows_back_rank.rule: Give your king an escape square (luft).

loses_center.rule: Control the center — don't give it up easily.

weakens_king.rule: Don't push pawns in front of your castled king.

trades_when_behind.rule: When behind in material, avoid trades.
trades_when_behind.short: Trading when behind helps your opponent.

trades_when_ahead.rule: When ahead in material, trade pieces to simplify.
trades_when_ahead.short: You should trade pieces when ahead.

premature_pawn_push.rule: Don't push pawns past the 4th rank before developing.

undeveloped_pieces.short: You attacked with pieces still undeveloped.

moved_same_piece_twice.rule: Don't move the same piece twice in the opening.
moved_same_piece_twice.short: Moving the same piece twice loses time.

delayed_castling.rule: Castle early to protect your king.
delayed_castling.short: Your king is still in the center.

unknown.rule: Calculate your opponent's best response before moving.
unknown.short: This move has a tactical flaw.
